title: The Verdict
subtitle: All four answers, one decision
description: The four answers arrive here. This file depends on the two
witnesses, the quorum, the first voice and the chapter rule --
one of them by alias -- and it asks for all four, overriding
the chapter's one_started for the reason a verdict needs.
size 112 and iconScale 0.4: a big node with a small picture in
it, so the table has a middle you can see across the canvas.
